method.design: paired independent samples on isolated DBs; sole intervention is promulgation_history force_promulgated markers 3 vs 0; opaque target IDs and arm run-order counterbalanced; single administrative midzhi test decree per arm ('中旨命内廷整理既有文册，不动外廷钱权'); board agenda neutral to the decree ('整肃吏治，慎核边饷'); 皇威=55
method.test: exact two-sided paired sign test (exact McNemar on discordant pairs)
method.oos_boundary: Acceptance evidence only. No production midzhi threshold, counter gate, or ratchet may be added (#556 OOS 中旨闸量化).
method.prior_red_diagnosis: r0 used 田亩清册 + 反对清丈 agenda → both arms 12/12 reject (scenario ceiling). r1 recalibrates to #561 admin midzhi + neutral agenda.

summary.diagnosis: judge_history_insensitive: clean arm can pass (scenario OK) but hist arm never rejects more — Judge does not differentially weight promulgation_history 批红强颁 markers (production prompt never names the field). Hold evidence; do not self-exempt AC④; no production ratchet.

limitations: One configured model/provider and one matched midzhi admin scenario; acceptance evidence, not population-wide calibration.
History is injected as durable decision rows (批红强颁 markers), not via a production counter; if the Judge ignores history the gate fails honestly.

Production promulgation Judge instructions do not name promulgation_history; a clean-pass + hist-insensitive result is engine-side evidence to hold, not a license to add production ratchet or self-exempt AC④ (P-4/P-7).
Repeated live-model calls may drift across provider/model revisions; embedded raw trace makes this run auditable.
Pairs share the same production Judge instruction and game snapshot shape; inference is conditional on that controlled snapshot.
